# ReplyNodes App Store Public Reads

> Read-only App Store API for iOS app metadata and ASO research through the ReplyNodes prepaid-credit fetcher. GET-only read capabilities with bearer API-key
> authentication at the gateway, bounded pages, normalized v1 payloads, and
> transparent errors plus an explicit unsupported-capability matrix.

Base URL: deployment-specific. Use https://api.replynodes.com as the ReplyNodes fetcher gateway base URL.

Setup: create a free account at https://app.replynodes.com/auth (500 one-time credits, no payment setup required), then create your fetcher API key at https://app.replynodes.com/developers. Store it as REPLYNODES_API_KEY and send it as Authorization: Bearer YOUR_FETCHER_KEY.

## Surface status

- All nine reviewed public read methods are exposed as stable capability identifiers in the manifest: app, list, search, developer, privacy, suggest, similar, reviews, and ratings.
- Each route uses the provider method name and exact option names; app-shaped results are normalized into the public App contract and raw provider records never cross the public gateway.
- No availability, uptime, latency, or success-rate figure is claimed; example payloads are illustrative fixtures.
- Package access uses prepaid credits only: one long-lived fetcher key is sent as Authorization: Bearer YOUR_FETCHER_KEY

## Endpoints

- `GET /v1/appstore/apps/{id}` - Look up one public App Store application (capability `app`; requires a ReplyNodes API key at the gateway).
  - Path parameter `id`: Numeric track id.
  - Query parameter `appId` (optional): Bundle id fallback.
  - Query parameter `country` (optional): Two-letter storefront code.
  - Query parameter `lang` (optional): Language code.
  - Query parameter `ratings` (optional): Include ratings information.
- `GET /v1/appstore/list` - List applications from a storefront collection (capability `list`; requires a ReplyNodes API key at the gateway).
  - Query parameter `collection` (optional): Provider collection constant.
  - Query parameter `category` (optional): Provider category constant.
  - Query parameter `country` (optional): Two-letter storefront code.
  - Query parameter `lang` (optional): Language code.
  - Query parameter `num` (optional): Number of applications; values outside 1..200 are rejected.
  - Query parameter `fullDetail` (optional): Request detail enrichment.
- `GET /v1/appstore/search` - Search public App Store applications by term (capability `search`; requires a ReplyNodes API key at the gateway).
  - Query parameter `term` (required): Search term.
  - Query parameter `num` (optional): Number of results; values outside 1..50 are rejected.
  - Query parameter `page` (optional): Result page.
  - Query parameter `country` (optional): Two-letter storefront code.
  - Query parameter `lang` (optional): Language code.
  - Query parameter `idsOnly` (optional): Return ids without detail lookups.
- `GET /v1/appstore/developer` - List applications by developer (capability `developer`; requires a ReplyNodes API key at the gateway).
  - Query parameter `devId` (required): public developer identifier.
  - Query parameter `country` (optional): Two-letter storefront code.
  - Query parameter `lang` (optional): Language code.
- `GET /v1/appstore/privacy` - Read public App Store privacy details (capability `privacy`; requires a ReplyNodes API key at the gateway).
  - Query parameter `id` (required): public application identifier.
- `GET /v1/appstore/suggest` - Suggest public App Store search terms (capability `suggest`; requires a ReplyNodes API key at the gateway).
  - Query parameter `term` (required): Search term.
- `GET /v1/appstore/apps/{id}/similar` - List apps related to an application (capability `similar`; requires a ReplyNodes API key at the gateway).
  - Path parameter `id`: Numeric track id.
  - Query parameter `appId` (optional): Bundle id fallback.
  - Query parameter `country` (optional): Two-letter storefront code.
  - Query parameter `lang` (optional): Language code.
- `GET /v1/appstore/reviews` - Read a page of public app reviews (capability `reviews`; requires a ReplyNodes API key at the gateway).
  - Query parameter `id` (optional): public application identifier; provide this or appId.
  - Query parameter `appId` (optional): Bundle id; provide this or id.
  - Query parameter `country` (optional): Two-letter storefront code.
  - Query parameter `page` (optional): Review page; values outside 1..10 are rejected.
  - Query parameter `sort` (optional): Provider review sort constant.
- `GET /v1/appstore/ratings` - Read public app ratings (capability `ratings`; requires a ReplyNodes API key at the gateway).
  - Query parameter `id` (optional): public application identifier; provide this or appId.
  - Query parameter `country` (optional): Two-letter storefront code.
  - Query parameter `appId` (optional): Bundle id; provide this or id.

## Essentials

- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_FETCHER_KEY` at the gateway; scope and entitlement enforcement belong to the shared control plane.
- Envelope: success `{data:[app records], meta{request_id, contract_version, generated_at, availability}}`; failure `{error:{code, message, request_id}}`.
- Correlation: supply an opaque request id per call; it is echoed as `meta.request_id`.
- Page bounds: Provider-specific limits are enforced by the pinned runtime; the gateway bounds request and response transport sizes without renaming options.
- Honesty rules: counters/scores/prices are `null` when the source omits them (zeros are never fabricated); `meta.availability` reports completeness; unknown upstream fields are dropped.
- Guarantees: GET-only public data; no purchase/review/account capability exists now or later; the read layer carries no credential material of any kind.

## Error codes

- `400 invalid_request`
- `404 not_found`
- `429 rate_limited`
- `502 upstream_unavailable`
- `503 degraded`

## Unsupported capabilities (do not improvise)

- `version_history` (not supported by pinned provider)
- `writes_auth_private` (read only policy)
